title: ZSDK Client Monitoring and Global Insights dashboards

prose.text: {{dashboard-release-history}} The dates of the Client Monitoring, Browser Access and Device Profile entries are not recorded here {{gap:release-note-dates}}, and retention and export are not stated {{gap:retention-and-export}}.

checks.do: Whether the Global Insights time range is within the previous three days.
Which network latency band a reading falls in on Uplink Health by Region: Good at or below 200 ms, Okay from 201 to 600 ms, Bad above 600 ms.

client-monitoring-overview.statement: The Client Monitoring dashboard (Dashboard > Client Monitoring) summarizes device usage across users and mobile devices: locations, operating systems, bandwidth usage, device usage, device models and hardware manufacturer; the time duration can be selected.

quotes: You can use this dashboard to gather device details about locations, operating systems, bandwidth usage, device usage, device models, and hardware manufacturer
select a time duration or refresh your dashboard to sync data
The Client Monitoring dashboard provides a high-level overview of device usage across your users and their mobile devices.
To adjust the Client Monitoring dashboard (Dashboard > Client Monitoring)

client-monitoring-location-panels.statement: Client Monitoring shows up to the top 10 locations by policy blocks, up to the top 10 by devices, and top locations by bandwidth usage (up to the top 10).

quotes: Top 10 Locations by Policy Blocks: Up to the top 10 locations that experience the highest number of policy blocks
Top 10 Locations by Devices: Up to the top 10 locations that have the highest number of users connect their mobile devices
Top Locations by Bandwidth Usage: Up to the top 10 locations with the highest bandwidth usage.

client-monitoring-charts.statement: Client Monitoring has a Device Trend Results line chart comparing high mobile device usage with a normal baseline, plus percentage pie charts of mobile devices for Operating System Version, Operating System, Device Model and Hardware Manufacturer.

quotes: Device Trend Results: A line chart with high mobile device usage as a trend when compared to a normal baseline.
Operating System Version: A percentage pie chart of the OS versions used across your users' mobile devices.
Device Model: A percentage pie chart of the mobile device models.
Hardware Manufacturer: A percentage pie chart of the hardware manufacturers for your users' mobile devices.
Operating System: A percentage pie chart of the mobile devices' operating systems.

global-insights-scope.statement: On the Global Insights dashboard a device is impacted when it participates in a Zscaler-secured application session during the selected time range, and the time range can go up to the previous three days.

quotes: A device is considered impacted when it participates in a Zscaler-secured application session during the selected time range.
Select a time range up to the previous three days to collect device data.

global-insights-overview-panels.statement: The Global Insights overview shows Total Sessions across all devices and up to the top 5 cities with sessions, top 5 locations with high latency and top 5 ISPs with high latency.

quotes: Total Sessions: The total number of Zscaler-secured application sessions across all devices in an organization.
Top Cities with Sessions: Up to the top 5 cities with the most sessions.
Top Locations with High Latency: Up to the top 5 locations with the highest latency.
Top ISPs with High Latency: Up to the top 5 ISPs with the highest latency.

global-insights-uplink-health.statement: Uplink Health by Region compares Wi-Fi and cellular health from impacted devices per region, showing uplink type, Latency (P90 ms), top ISP, health and the Android/iOS device OS split; health is Good at or below 200 ms, Okay from 201 to 600 ms and Bad above 600 ms.

quotes: Uplink Health by Region: View the comparison table between Wi-Fi and cellular health from impacted devices
Latency (P90 ms): The 90th percentile network latency of the devices.
Android/iOS: The percentage of device OS distribution.
Good: The network latency is below or equal to 200 ms.
Okay: The network latency is within the range of 201 ms to 600 ms.
Bad: The network latency is above 600 ms.
Uplink Type: The type of internet access (e.g., Cellular, Wi-Fi).
Top ISP: The ISP name that has the most impacted devices.
evidence.after: Region: The region where there are impacted devices.

global-insights-isp-leaderboard.statement: The ISP Leaderboard lists the most impacted ISPs with regions affected, P90 latency, session share (the percentage of application sessions sending traffic through the ISP) and health.

quotes: ISP Leaderboard: View the most impacted ISPs
Regions: The number of impacted regions.
Session Share: The percentage of application sessions that are sending traffic through the ISP.
Latency (P90 ms): The 90th percentile network latency of the devices.
Health: The health of the internet access.

global-insights-heatmap-network-path.statement: The Global Session Heatmap colours latency experience green (best), yellow (average) and red (worst), and the Network Path section shows Sankey visualizations of network paths between Zscaler and App Connectors.

quotes: Green: Best latency experience.
Yellow: Average latency experience.
Red: Worst latency experience.
Network Path: View Sankey visualizations to observe the network paths between Zscaler and App Connectors.

dashboard-release-history.statement: Release notes dated December 12, 2025 record that the Global Insights dashboard gained a Wi-Fi vs cellular comparison table and an ISP Leaderboard and lost the interactive Threat Detector map; notes dated February 13, 2026 record Sankey visualizations of network paths and renamed fields (Wi-Fi vs. Cellular Health by Region to Uplink Health by Region, Device Share to Session Share).

quotes: A comparison table between Wi-Fi and cellular access on devices
An ISP Leaderboard that displays the most impacted internet service providers (ISPs)
The interactive Threat Detector map is no longer available
The Global Insights dashboard includes Sankey visualizations to evaluate latency experience on network paths
Wi-Fi vs. Cellular Health by Region section to Uplink Health by Region
Device Share to Session Share

release-note-dates.title: Which release date the Client Monitoring, Browser Access and Device Profile release note entries belong to
release-note-dates.detail: The Global Insights entries sit under the December 12, 2025 and February 13, 2026 date headings (dashboard-release-history). The Client Monitoring, Browser Access and Device Profile entries have not been tied to their date headings in a claim.

retention-and-export.title: Data retention and export for the Client Monitoring and Global Insights dashboards
retention-and-export.detail: The Global Insights article allows a time range up to the previous three days. Neither dashboard article states a retention period beyond that, or an export option.
